Town Planning in Mehrgarh
During the excavation, a large number of items were discovered, including figurines,
polychrome pottery, bronze shaft-hole axe, beads, and seals, demonstrating the presence
of a highly developed society. The presence of cotton seeds suggests the use of fiber for
textile production. The Mehrgarians' remnants can still be seen at Balochistan's Sibi cattle
exhibition and the turban worn by the inhabitants of Balochistan.

Jean-Francois Jarrige (1940-2014) and his wife Catherine (1942) were two of the most
well-known archaeologists in South Asia, whose excavations at Mehrgarh were very
important. According to their research, Mehrgarians used a variety of specific artisan
techniques . Pottery and necklaces with glazed steatite beads were among the items
discovered during the graveyard dig.
